I need pet-friendly accommodations for 2 people with MINIMUM NIGHTS <= 2 in Dayton, Cincinnati, and Columbus. 

The CSV file is: /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv
Format: Index,NAME,room type,price,minimum nights,review rate number,house_rules,maximum occupancy,city

Pet-friendly means house_rules does NOT contain "No pets".
Need maximum_occupancy >= 2 and minimum_nights <= 2.

Please run these commands and show ALL output:

```bash
echo "=== DAYTON ==="
grep ",Dayton$" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"

echo ""
echo "=== CINCINNATI ==="
grep ",Cincinnati$" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"

echo ""
echo "=== COLUMBUS ==="
grep ",Columbus$" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"
```

Then tell me which ones have minimum_nights <= 2 and maximum_occupancy >= 2. I need affordable ones - around $100-$500/night range ideally.
